title: A Guiding Light of Fond Devotion

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a week left until Mejiro Bright's
race in the tryouts. I've got to
figure out
how to realize her potential before then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
First things first,
let me introduce you to
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
From the left, we have the elegant Dober,
followed by the proud McQueen. And last
but not least, the kind Ryan, whom I love
very
dearly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, welcome to our tea party. Oh, and
Bright? Who's this again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, this is Provisional Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Provisional?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. The tryouts are indeed
approaching, and having a
professional
give you feedback is very important.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So? Spill the beans—how's Bright holding
up? You two might've just
started training,
but still, I gotta know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hah, whew... Aaand now! O-oh my. It
seems I've crossed the finish
line again...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as I'd suspected,
her starts could use
some work—probably due to her mellow
manner. On top of that, she tends to
forget to accelerate in the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Do you mind if I keep running for a bit?
I'm still brimming with energy,
so let us
move on to the next training item.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still,
her running form itself isn't bad at all.
From an objective
standpoint, she
definitely has the ideal legs for racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I can coach some strategy and timing
into her, then she should be
able to make
up for her weaknesses. Now she just
needs—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Provisional Trainer, would you like some
tea? It goes very well with a
dash of apple
compote. Give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Pleasant, isn't it? A cup of tea can make
you feel all warm and fuzzy.
Perfect for a
cold winter's day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, Dober taught me
this. She has it all together,
and she's
taught me countless things. Isn't she just
lovely?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And when I'm out basking in the sun,
McQueen often comes to drape
a blanket
over me. I'm blessed by her kindness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And I haven't even begun to speak of her beautiful running! She's elegant and gorgeous—my ideal. Every time she runs, I'm mesmerized.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right?! It doesn't get better than
McQueen's running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Teehee. I love your running too, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Each of your steps is filled with
power, as if you're bounding off the
earth with each
stride. It reflects your strength of will,
and I admire that very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, now you're just laying it on thick!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's all true,
you know? I sincerely respect
and admire all of you here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, we're surrounded by brilliant
talents. I'm sure that if Bright
hosted the
upcoming event, it would turn out to be a
great success.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A meet and greet is being held soon where
Mejiro racers who've
made their debuts
interact with their fans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dober and I have yet to debut, so we shall
only be watching. Ah, but
if you would
like, please do join us,
Provisional Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the tea party, everyone returns to
the academy. I'm currently
waiting for my
provisional trainee, Mejiro Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright's train—I mean Provisional Trainer!
Just wanted to say thanks
for today. It was
fun having you around!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't sweat it.
Didn't Bright drag you
there anyways? I'm sure
she had her own
reasons.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You know how she's always so chill and
laid-back? Actually, she's a
real tough
cookie.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha, yup! I'm not the kind of gal
someone should be lookin' up to. But when
Bright tells me how much I mean to her,
even I... can believe
in myself a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So if Bright's picked you out as her
trainer,
then I bet she's got a
good reason. Make
sure you take good care of her, all right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ryan brings up a good point. Why did
Mejiro Bright trust me with
overseeing her
training? I guess I should ask her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, if I had to say, it's because you
watched that leaf together with
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As you can probably tell,
I'm a bit of an airhead. Compared to
my peers, it
takes me longer to gather my thoughts,
and even longer to improve myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've always been like this,
even when I was
a child. I've failed to live
up to the
expectations of so many people.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family,
there is no greater shame.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Be that as it may,
I still believe in my own
abilities. Though I may walk in the shadow
of my peers,
I am still a Mejiro through and through.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to enter the tryouts so I could
finally show the world my true
potential.
Yet as I was, I could not hope to
accomplish that goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is when I met you. When I was
spacing out towards the sky, you
adapted
yourself to my pace and accompanied me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You understood me for who I was, and who
I could yet become. Just as Ryan once
showed me glimmers of hope, you ignited
a new spark
within me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've decided—
I will become the light of the
Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The light of the Mejiro family...
Behind her
gentle tone lies a fiery,
smoldering
determination—her reason for running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That resolve is the final piece of the
puzzle. After all, the first step to
any
journey starts with a wish. Now we just
have to put in the work.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Once I hear the signal, I'll pick up the pace... I just need to be ready—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pant... Right! Here... I go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying to teach her when to
accelerate.
It takes time to speed up,
so I give her the
signal a bit early.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah... Provisional Trainer, did I
accelerate at the right time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad. Having a signal to watch out
for is very helpful. I can run
more freely
when I have something like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no guarantee Bright will be
able to replicate this success
during the tryouts. Still,
she has her own reasons for winning, and
that'll surely push her past the finish
line.
